records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net sales for the three months ended September 30, 2022 increased $28.4 million, or 35.5%, to $108.4 million compared with $80.0 million for the three months ended September 30, 2021.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Orders booked increased $9.1 million, or 9.8%, to $101.7 million during the three months ended September 30, 2022 compared with $92.6 million in the three months ended September 30, 2021.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Some of our facilities and our suppliers have experienced temporary disruptions as a result of the COVID-19 pandemic, and we continue to work closely with our global supply chain to proactively support customers during this critical time.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Although we have secured additional raw materials from existing and alternate suppliers and have taken other mitigating actions to mitigate supply disruptions, such as implementing price increases and applying material surcharges.
